Which overall colour palette should we use?

❯ 1. Light neutral (Recommended)
     White or off-white background with dark text. Reads clearly in print and on most screens.
  2. Dark neutral
     Dark background with light text. Easier on the eyes at night, but harder to read in bright
     light.
  3. Brand colours
     Use your brand colours as the base palette. Needs the exact hex values from you.
  4. Type something.
